Rashi on Niddah 38a:11:1.english: If so - Since you reckon the eighty [days] of a female.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:11:2.hebrew: יש מקשה לעולם - ואינה זבה, כגון: טובלת לי"ד של נקבה ומתעברת, ולסוף שמונים, שבעה לנדה ושנים לאחר הנדה, ומקשה חמשים, וחוזרת ומפלת נקבה, וכן לעולם:
Rashi on Niddah 38a:11:2.english: There is [a woman who] experiences labor pains forever - And she does not become a zava. For example, she immerses on the fourteenth [day after giving birth to] a female and conceives, and at the end of the eighty [days], [she has] seven [days] of menstruation and two [days] after the menstruation, and experiences labor pains for fifty [days], and then miscarries a female [fetus], and so on forever.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:1:1.hebrew: אף ימים הראויין לספירת סתירת זבה - בימי זיבה, דלעולם היא טהורה עד שתשפה, שהרי כל ימיה ראויין לכך, שאם תספור ששה ותראה – סותרת הכל, ונמצאו הימים הבאין ראויין לספירה. והא דתניא: "בימי נדה נדה" – היכא דאתחיל קושי מימי נדה; אבל אתחיל בימי זיבה – כל מה שיאריך הקושי, טהורה:
Rashi on Niddah 38a:1:1.english: Even days that are fit for the counting of the negation of a zava - [If the labor pains began] during the days of ziva, she remains pure indefinitely until [the pain] subsides; for all her [subsequent] days are fit for this: as, if she counts six [clean days] and sees [blood], she negates everything, and the following days turn out to be fit for counting. And that which is taught [in a baraita]: "During the days of niddah, [she is] a niddah" — [that applies] where the labor pains began during the days of niddah; but if they began during the days of ziva, for however long the labor pains persist, she is pure.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:2:1.english: And furthermore, forty and fifty days - [The Gemara] initially assumed that Rabbi Meir completely purifies her from [both] zivah and niddah.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:4:1.hebrew: בימי נדה נדה - וה"ק ר"מ: כמה הוא קשויה שלא תבא להתחייב בקרבן ולספירת נקיים? ארבעים וחמשים יום. ומיהו, בכל הני ארבעים, כי שלמי ימי זוב ומטו ימי נדות - טמאה נדה, וכי הדרי שלמי ז' ימי נדות ומטו ימי זוב - טהורה:
Rashi on Niddah 38a:4:1.english: During the days of menstruation, [she is] a menstruating woman - And this is what Rabbi Meir is saying: How long is [the period of] her labor pains so that she does not become obligated in an offering and the counting of clean [days]? Forty or fifty days. However, throughout all these forty [days], when the days of zivah conclude and the days of menstruation arrive, she is impure as a menstruating woman; and when the seven days of menstruation conclude in turn and the days of zivah arrive, she is pure.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:5:1.hebrew: זבה גדולה - ראתה שלשה רצופין בתוך י"א יום, טהורה מספירת נקיים ומקרבן. אבל לא ראתה אלא יום אחד, צריכה לשמור יום כנגד יום. דכי כתיב "דמה", דדרשינן: "ולא מחמת ולד", בזבה גדולה כתיב, דכתיב בההוא קרא "ימים רבים". ואם משך קשויה יותר מאחד עשר יום, שנכנסה לימים שראויים לנדה - טמאה:
Rashi on Niddah 38a:5:1.english: A greater zava - [If] she saw [blood on] three consecutive [days] within the eleven days, she is pure from counting clean [days] and from a sacrifice. But [if] she saw [blood on] only one day, she must observe [a clean] day corresponding to [that] day. For when "her blood" is written, from which we derive: "and not on account of a child," it is written regarding a greater zava, as it is written in that verse: "many days." And if her labor was prolonged more than eleven days, so that she entered days that are fit for menstruation, she is impure.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:6:1.english: "Days" and "all the days of the issue of her impurity," etc. - And from them we derive [the law of] a lesser zava at the end of our tractate, in the last sugya.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:7:1.hebrew: קשיא לתרוייהו - דאמרי זבה גדולה וקטנה הוא דמטהר ולד, אבל אם יאריך אחריהן — טמא:
Rashi on Niddah 38a:7:1.english: This is difficult for both of them - For they say that it is [only the days of] a greater zava and a lesser zava that a child purifies, but if [the labor] extends beyond them, [it is] impure.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:7:2.english: During the days of ziva - To one Master according to his view, and to the other Master according to his view.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:8:1.english: There is [a woman] who experiences labor pains - That she sees [blood].

Rashi on Niddah 38a:8:2.english: One hundred and fifty days - [They are] consecutive.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:8:3.english: And zivah is not included in them - And not that she is in labor for all 150 days.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:8:4.hebrew: כיצד ראתה ב' בלא עת - בלא עת נדה. הרי י"א ימים שלאחר נדתה שהן ימי זיבה, ואינה זבה עד שתראה בהן ג' רצופין. ואם ראתה שנים בסופן, כשתראה למחר הוי פתח של נדותה, ואינו מצטרף לה לזיבה, אלא תחלת נדה הויא, וכל שבעה תהיה נדה – הרי ט' ימים רצופין. ושנים שלאחר הנדה, שהן מן י"א של ימי זוב, וכל כמה דלא חזיא ג' בימי זיבה לא הויא זבה – הרי י"א רצופין. וקשתה חמשים, והיא חולה, ואמרינן לעיל: בחולה חמשים – הרי ס"א. וביום ס"א ילדה נקבה, ואפילו רואה כל שמונים אינה זבה, ואחד ושמונים הוי תחילת נדה. ואם תראה ז' – הרי מאה ומ"ח, ושנים שלאחר הנדה, ותפסוק – הרי ראתה ק"נ רצופין ואינה זבה. אבל אם תראה יותר – הויא זבה, דהוו להו ג' לאחר הנדה:
Rashi on Niddah 38a:8:4.english: How so? She saw two [days] not at the time - Not at the time of niddah. Behold, the eleven days that follow her niddah are the days of zivah, and she does not become a zava until she sees [blood] on three consecutive [days] during them. And if she saw [blood on] two [days] at their end, when she sees [blood] on the morrow, it is the onset of her niddah and it does not combine for her toward zivah; rather, it is the beginning of niddah, and all seven [days] she will be a niddah — behold, nine consecutive days. And two [days] after the niddah, which are from the eleven days of zov, and as long as she does not see three [days] during the days of zivah, she does not become a zava — behold, eleven consecutive [days]. And she experienced labor pains for fifty [days], and she is ill, and we said above: for an ill woman, fifty [days] — behold, sixty-one. And on the sixty-first day she gave birth to a female; and even if she sees [blood] all eighty [days of the post-partum period], she does not become a zava, and the eighty-first [day] is the start of niddah. And if she sees [blood for] seven [days] — behold, one hundred and forty-eight; and two [days] after the niddah, and then she stops [bleeding] — behold, she has seen [blood for] one hundred and fifty consecutive [days] and is not a zava. However, if she sees more, she becomes a zava, for there would be three [consecutive days of bleeding] after the niddah.

Rashi on Niddah 38a:9:1.english: And fifty that the child purifies - Those fifty [days] of labor pains before the eighty [days of purity for a female].

Tosafot on Niddah 38a:5:1.hebrew: להיות בהן זבה גדולה - רש"י פירש לאפוקי י' וי"א, דאינה ראויה להתחיל בהן זבה גדולה; ור"ח פירש לאפוקי יום ראשון ויום שני של י"א, דאינה ראויה עדיין להיות זבה גדולה אם לא תראה יום ג':
Tosafot on Niddah 38a:5:1.english: To become a greater zava in them - Rashi explained [this] to exclude the tenth and eleventh [days], as she is not fit to begin [becoming] a greater zava on them; and Rabbeinu Chananel explained [this] to exclude the first day and the second day of the eleven [days], as she is not yet fit to become a greater zava unless she sees [blood on] the third day.
